information_flow: The first call receives every common input and commits one complete executable policy closure as the lineage's sole behavior-bearing artifact. The final call receives only that immediately preceding closure, cannot reinterpret or revise its behavioral choices, and emits the same artifact as one policy.
name: Linear Upstream Policy Custody
organization: two-call sequential lineage with fully informed upstream commitment and non-discretionary terminal custody

calls.objective: Reconcile the visible evidence and obligations once, then commit one complete executable policy closure as the sole behavior-bearing artifact for the lineage.
Consume commit_binding_closure, preserve its behavioral identity without reinterpretation or revision, and emit its complete policy artifact as the single final policy.
